facts.text: John recalls a game in which his team was down 10 points in the 4th quarter and he made a buzzer-beater shot to win.

evidence.quote: I've had some thrilling games in my career. My favorite was when we were down 10 in the 4th and I hit the buzzer-beater shot to win.

facts.text: John mentions that a photo of a basketball ball on the ground with a basketball hoop in the background reminds him of his younger years practicing basketball outside for hours.

evidence.quote: That pic reminds me of when I was younger. I'd practice basketball outside for hours, dreaming of playing in big games.
I still think about this pic you sent me a while back.

facts.text: John states that practicing basketball outside helped him deal with doubts and stress during his younger years.

evidence.quote: It was my way of dealing with doubts and stress.

facts.text: Tim comments on how sports, particularly basketball, have been a significant part of John's life and have allowed him to be himself and pursue his passions.

evidence.quote: It's been a significant part of my life and allows me to be myself and pursue my passions.
